headlines.title: Some lawmakers doubt a Congress that’s ‘barely capable of email’ can regulate AI
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — Amid warnings that artificial intelligence could soon wipe out humanity, some lawmakers are not confident that Congress has the expertise or ability to regulate AI.

headlines.title: Bill Gates says AI companies self-regulating isn’t enough and governments should be involved
headlines.description: Bill Gates called for lawmakers in Washington to regulate the development of artificial intelligence, weeks after the CEOs of some of the nation’s biggest AI labs agreed on the need to slow the pace of AI progress.

headlines.title: It’s cute. It’s cuddly. And it wants your data.
headlines.description: Meta is touting its new personal AI agent, Muse, as a product “built for everyone” — including those who lack experience with technology.

headlines.title: Mark Zuckerberg rejects calls for industrywide AI slowdown
headlines.description: In an interview with NBC News chief tech analyst Joanna Stern, the Meta founder and CEO said he doesn’t think AI companies need to work together on a slowdown.

headlines.title: AI-generated products push Etsy sellers off platform
headlines.description: Former Etsy Seller Emily Olson quit the platform after she says AI slop took over, making it harder to compete with cheap, digital pieces. The trend reflects the broader debate surrounding AI and art, and whether they can peacefully co-exist.

headlines.title: China's AI ambitions: automated factories, free models and a growing challenge to the U.S.
headlines.description: Inside China's push to embed AI in every corner of its economy — from robotic factories to open-source models rivaling the United States’ frontier labs. NBC News' Janis Mackey Frayer reports from Beijing.

headlines.title: Mark Zuckerberg Shares Vision for AI, How His Own Family Uses It
headlines.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg speaks with NBC News in collaboration with Joanna Stern’s platform “The New Things,” about artificial intelligence, his goal to integrate AI into everyday life, how his own family uses the technology and the threat it could pose. “I’m quite optimistic about the fact that this is going to be a very positive future for everyone,” he says, adding, “People aren’t going to adopt it if they don’t trust it…We’re entering a phase where trust and alignment i

headlines.title: AI glasses: The lens technology bringing AI into your line of sight
headlines.description: AI glasses are moving beyond simple displays. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer visits South Korean startup LetinAR to explore its PinTILT lens technology, designed to put AI and digital information directly in your line of sight.

headlines.title: Zuckerberg shows Meta's audio-only glasses, addresses safety concerns
headlines.description: NBC News' Joanna Stern sat down with Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg to talk about their audio-only glasses and how the company is responding to people misusing the products.

headlines.title: 'People must remain at the center of AI decision-making,' OpenAI CEO says
headlines.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Dario Amodei, the CEO of Anthropic, spoke about the risks of artificial intelligence in their remarks at the United Nations General Assembly. The top AI chief executives stressed that people should remain at the center of AI decision-making.

headlines.title: FBI investigating after hackers claim they stole sensitive data about agents
headlines.description: The FBI said it was investigating after a hacker group said they broke into a database and stole sensitive information regarding the bureau's agents. The group allegedly responsible said the attack was not financially motivated.

headlines.title: Man versus Robot: Influencer takes on humanoid robot in cage match
headlines.description: An influencer stepped into the ring to take on a six-foot, 200-pound robot. NBC News’ Steven Romo takes a closer look at the match.
